what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Yemen in Egypt: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 10166 Yemeni asylum seekers in Egypt, 39.3% of all asylum seekers from Yemen.
Refugees from Yemen, a separate group, live mostly in Somalia, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Yemen in every year from 2008 to 2025, at war level in most of them, with Ansarallah, AQAP and the Alliance of Yemeni Tribes among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2018 to 2025, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 22 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Egypt.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Egypt only.
